verdict.rationale: Calendly's scheduling page says users can "fine-tune your availability with meeting buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits" so they "only get booked when you want to be." That covers buffers and daily booking caps, though only as a single marketing line. A community request for a cap on total booked hours per day is a different control from a count-based daily limit, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: minimum scheduling notice, date-range booking windows, explicit before-and-after buffer detail, in-depth first-party docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
